headline: Deadlocked adds core and network code alongside PAL-specific functions
summary: Deadlocked's NTSC-U v1.00 progress report rises from 4.41% to 4.54% matched code, with 3,598 of 18,085 functions. A matched function compiles to exactly the same bytes as the original game. The landed work includes 103 core, network and resident-text functions in #31, plus separate work on PAL timing differences and PAL-only functions (#32, #33, #34, #35).
highlights: PAL-specific implementations cover timing differences associated with its 50 Hz release (#32). These are separate from the NTSC-U progress figure.
Three further PAL-only functions were proposed in #36, which had not merged.
Contributor documentation explains how to use OpenRAC's shared permuter for both US and PAL builds (#37).
